claims.claim: Applied Digital has announced a $3.2 billion, 210-megawatt AI data center called Delta Forge 2 near Brookwood in Tuscaloosa County, Alabama.
claims.episode_span: Applied Digital has announced a 210-megawatt AI data center, Delta Forge 2, near Brookwood in Alabama’s Tuscaloosa County, and puts the project at $3.2 billion.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: Applied Digital has revealed that its $3.2 billion Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be located near Brookwood, Alabama.

claims.claim: The Brookwood campus is on 1,300 acres, spans 1.2 million square feet at full build-out, and is expected to begin operations in 2028.
claims.episode_span: The campus sits on 1,300 acres and spans 1.2 million square feet at full build-out, with operations expected to begin in 2028.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: It has now revealed it will be built on a 1,300-acre site near Brookwood, in Alabama’s Tuscaloosa County.

claims.claim: Delta Forge 2 is expected to support up to 1,000 construction jobs and 100 permanent roles.
claims.episode_span: It is set to support up to 1,000 construction jobs and 100 permanent roles.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: According to Applied Digital, the project will support up to 1,000 construction jobs and create 100 permanent roles.

claims.claim: In June Applied Digital said it had secured a customer for a 210-megawatt data center and did not then announce the location.
claims.episode_span: in June it had said that customer was secured for a 210-megawatt center without naming this site.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: The company revealed in June that it had secured a customer for a new 210MW data center, but did not announce its location.

claims.claim: Applied Digital describes the Delta Forge 2 customer as an investment-grade hyperscaler.
claims.episode_span: Applied Digital describes the customer as an investment-grade hyperscaler
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: Applied Digital describes it as an “investment grade hyperscaler”.

claims.claim: Applied Digital is committing $270 million in community benefits over 20 years and estimates $131 million in tax revenue.
claims.episode_span: The company is committing $270 million in community benefits to the Tuscaloosa County Economic Development Authority over 20 years, alongside an estimated $131 million in tax revenue.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: Applied Digital is committing $270 million in community benefits payments to the Tuscaloosa County Economic Development Authority over 20 years, alongside an estimated $131m in tax revenue that will be generated for the area.

claims.claim: Applied Digital’s contracted portfolio spans five AI Factory campuses, 1.4 gigawatts of critical IT load, and about 2.15 gigawatts of grid-connected utility power.
claims.episode_span: Its contracted portfolio now spans five AI Factory campuses, totaling 1.4 gigawatts of critical IT load and approximately 2.15 gigawatts of grid-connected utility power.
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: Its contracted portfolio now spans five AI Factory campuses, totaling 1.4GW of critical IT load, and approximately 2.15GW of grid-connected utility power.

claims.claim: Jeremy Werner of Micron says agentic AI runs on two compute stacks, with the GPU reasoning and planning and the CPU orchestrating actions.
claims.episode_span: says agentic AI runs on two compute stacks rather than one. The GPU reasons and plans, while the CPU orchestrates actions.
claims.source_title: Micron SVP explains agentic AI needs two compute stacks and more memory
claims.supporting_quote: As Micron SVP & GM, Core Data Center Business Unit, Jeremy Werner explains, agentic AI runs on two compute stacks, not one. The GPU reasons and plans, while the CPU orchestrates actions.

claims.claim: Werner says KV cache keeps AI context available and that growing context and agentic workloads drive memory needs beyond reasoning alone.
claims.episode_span: KV cache is the technology he points to for keeping context available. He says growing context sizes and agentic workloads are driving memory needs far beyond reasoning alone.
claims.source_title: Micron SVP explains agentic AI needs two compute stacks and more memory
claims.supporting_quote: Technologies like KV cache keep AI context available, but growing context sizes and agentic workloads are driving memory needs far beyond reasoning alone.

claims.claim: ServeTheHome reviewed the ASRock Rack SORANOD8-2L2T motherboard for the AMD EPYC 8005 Sorano series and said it provides lots of connectivity.
claims.episode_span: ServeTheHome has published a review of the ASRock Rack SORANOD8-2L2T, a new motherboard for the AMD EPYC 8005 “Sorano” series.
claims.source_title: ASRock Rack SORANOD8-2L2T Review A New AMD EPYC 8005 Sorano Motherboard
claims.supporting_quote: We review the ASRock Rack SORANOD8-2L2T which is a new motherboard providing lots of connectivity for the AMD EPYC 8005 Sorano series

claims.claim: Fraunhofer IAF developed a monolithic microwave integrated circuit described as a broadband distributed amplifier for modern data centers, measurement systems and sensors.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Solid State Physics IAF have developed a monolithic microwave integrated circuit for modern data centers, measurement systems and sensors.
claims.source_title: Broadband Distributed Amplifier for Data Centers, Measurement Systems and Sensors
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Solid State Physics IAF have developed a monolithic microwave integrated circuit (MMIC) with outstanding performance for modern data centers.

claims.claim: Vertiv has agreed to acquire Ireland-based King Environmental Services, which provides fluid management, commissioning and load-testing for high-density liquid-cooled data centers, to expand thermal services into EMEA.
claims.episode_span: Vertiv has agreed to acquire Ireland-based King Environmental Services, which provides fluid management, commissioning and load-testing for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers.
claims.source_title: Vertiv to acquire data center fluid management firm King Environmental Services
claims.supporting_quote: The power and cooling vendor has agreed a deal for Ireland-based KES, which provides fluid management, commissioning and load-testing services for high-density, liquid-cooled data centers and other applications.

claims.claim: Vertiv bought PurgeRite last year for more than $1 billion and already offers fluid management in North America.
claims.episode_span: Last year Vertiv bought PurgeRite, another firm in the same work, for more than $1 billion.
claims.source_title: Vertiv to acquire data center fluid management firm King Environmental Services
claims.supporting_quote: Vertiv already offers fluid management to clients in North America, and last year bought another company that operates in the space, PurgeRite , in a deal worth more than $1 billion.

claims.claim: Gio Albertazzi said cooling and power performance will depend as much on field execution as on engineering and system design as computing density increases.
claims.episode_span: Chief executive Gio Albertazzi said that as computing density increases, cooling and power performance “will depend as much on execution in the field as on engineering and system design.”
claims.source_title: Vertiv to acquire data center fluid management firm King Environmental Services
claims.supporting_quote: “As computing density increases, the performance of cooling and power infrastructure will depend as much on execution in the field as on engineering and system design,” said Gio Albertazzi, CEO of Vertiv.

claims.claim: KES was founded in 2002, is headquartered near Dublin, serves EMEA, and its website features projects for Microsoft and Equinix.
claims.episode_span: KES, founded in 2002 and headquartered near Dublin, serves customers across EMEA, and its site lists projects for Microsoft and Equinix.
claims.source_title: Vertiv to acquire data center fluid management firm King Environmental Services
claims.supporting_quote: KES is headquartered near Dublin, Ireland, and serves customers across the EMEA region. Founded in 2002, its website features projects it has undertaken for the likes of Microsoft and Equinix.

claims.claim: The Vertiv acquisition of KES is expected to close before the end of the year.
claims.episode_span: Vertiv expects the King Environmental Services acquisition to close before the end of 2026.
claims.source_title: Vertiv to acquire data center fluid management firm King Environmental Services
claims.supporting_quote: Financial terms have not been disclosed, and the deal is expected to close before the end of the year.

claims.claim: Data Center Knowledge reports that infrasound from data centers is increasingly scrutinized by communities and that proactive mitigation and transparent communication are essential for operators.
claims.episode_span: Data Center Knowledge reports that infrasound produced by data centers is increasingly scrutinized by communities.
claims.source_title: Low-Frequency Noise and Data Centers: What to Know
claims.supporting_quote: Infrasound produced by data centers is increasingly scrutinized by communities, making proactive mitigation and transparent communication essential for operators.

claims.claim: ACCM’s Wisconsin facility is set to bring laminate capacity of 20 million square feet per year online in January 2027 and build-up and prepreg capacity of 87 million square feet per year online in November 2026.
claims.episode_span: Laminate capacity of 20 million square feet per year is scheduled online in January 2027. Build-up and prepreg capacity of 87 million square feet per year is scheduled online in November 2026.
claims.source_title: ACCM Expands US Manufacturing Capacity Across Four Advanced Materials Segments for AI Infrastructure
claims.supporting_quote: ACCM's Wisconsin facility will bring online laminate capacity of 20 million square feet per year in January 2027, with build-up and prepreg capacity of 87 million square feet per year online in November 2026.

claims.claim: Semiconductor Engineering’s week in review says chip supply chains are tightening for equipment and critical materials, TSMC partners are accelerating, and China is doubling down on AI compute and memory.
claims.episode_span: Semiconductor Engineering’s week in review reports that chip supply chains are tightening for equipment and critical materials.
claims.source_title: Chip Industry Week In Review
claims.supporting_quote: China doubles down on AI compute and memory; chip supply chains tighten for equipment and critical materials; TSMC partners accelerate

claims.claim: Dylan Patel wrote that a fully populated GB300 NVL72 weighs roughly 1,580 kilograms and that recent purchase orders put it at $5 million per rack.
claims.episode_span: Dylan Patel wrote that a fully populated GB300 NVL72 weighs roughly 1,580 kilograms, that recent purchase orders put the rack at 5 million dollars
claims.source_title: Fentanyl Grade Compute: GB300 Rack Value Comparison
claims.supporting_quote: A GB300 NVL72 weighs roughly 1,580 kg fully populated and recent purchase orders put it at $5M per rack.

claims.claim: Patel wrote that the GB200 NVL72 was $4 million and that Vera Rubin NVL72 is quoted at up to $8.8 million at essentially the same rack mass.
claims.episode_span: the GB200 NVL72 was 4 million dollars, and that Vera Rubin NVL72 is already quoted at up to 8.8 million dollars at essentially the same rack mass.
claims.source_title: Fentanyl Grade Compute: GB300 Rack Value Comparison
claims.supporting_quote: GB200 NVL72 was $4M, GB300 is ~$5M, and Vera Rubin NVL72 is already quoted at up to $8.8M at essentially the same rack mass.

claims.claim: Patel wrote that HBM, CoWoS and power are supply-limited and that rack weight is constrained by datacenter floor loading.
claims.episode_span: Patel's point is that those three stay supply-limited, so dollars per kilogram rise while floor loading holds the kilogram count still.
claims.source_title: Fentanyl Grade Compute: GB300 Rack Value Comparison
claims.supporting_quote: Rack weight is constrained by the datacenter floor loading; rack price is constrained by nothing. That's ~1.75x $/kg per generation with HBM, CoWoS and power all supply-limited through the decade.

claims.claim: Polaris Forge 3 will offer 300 megawatts of critical IT load on 600 acres in an unnamed northern state to the same hyperscaler as Delta Forge 1, with initial operations anticipated in August 2027.
claims.episode_span: Applied Digital anticipates initial operations in August 2027 at Polaris Forge 3, a 300-megawatt critical IT load on 600 acres in an unnamed northern state
claims.source_title: Applied Digital reveals $3.2bn Delta Forge 2 AI data center will be built in Alabama
claims.supporting_quote: Located on 600 acres in an unnamed northern state, Polaris Forge 3 will offer 300MW of critical IT load to the same US-based, high-investment-grade hyperscaler that previously signed on for capacity at Applied’s Delta Forge 1 campus. Initial operations at Polaris Forge 3 are anticipated to commence in August 2027.
